She speaks directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. The background is a clean, white-walled clinic setting featuring a prominent logo for 'DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC'. (2) Graphical overlays appear around her as she speaks. A 'Google' logo and floating Chinese text for 'Fasting' and 'Intermittent Fasting' are introduced to emphasize her points. The lighting is bright and professional, mimicking a clinical or studio environment. (3) The visual focus remains on the woman as animated illustrations appear over her torso. These include a farm scene and a depiction of cavemen hunting a mammoth, used to visually explain historical food scarcity. Her facial expressions remain focused and informative. (4) Dynamic text overlays like 'BURN OFF' and '熱量' (Calories) appear with a yellow-to-red glow. A cartoon white mascot character is shown on screen to represent the body's storage mechanism. The woman continues gesturing towards her midsection to illustrate fat storage. (5) A list with blue checkmarks appears on the left side of the screen, enumerating medical terms like 'Free Radicals' and 'Zombie Cells'. The woman continues her detailed explanation, maintaining a steady eyeline with the viewer. (6) The video transitions to a final static screen with a white background. It displays the 'DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC' logo, a LINE ID, a phone number, and two physical addresses in New Taipei and Taipei cities.
